import hashlib, json, pathlib, subprocess, sys, time, os

def main():
    root = pathlib.Path.cwd()
    prog = root / "sortints.py"
    py = sys.executable
    env = dict(os.environ)
    env["PYTHONHASHSEED"] = "0"
    meta = json.loads((root / "bench_meta.json").read_text())
    cases = [(root / c["file"], int(c["n"]), c["sha256"]) for c in meta["cases"]]

    def run_file(path, sha=None):
        with path.open("rb") as f:
            t0 = time.perf_counter()
            p = subprocess.run([py, str(prog)], stdin=f, stdout=subprocess.PIPE,
                               stderr=subprocess.PIPE, env=env)
            dt = time.perf_counter() - t0
        if p.returncode != 0:
            return None, dt
        if sha is not None and hashlib.sha256(p.stdout).hexdigest() != sha:
            return None, dt
        return p.stdout, dt

    def run_bytes(data):
        p = subprocess.run([py, str(prog)], input=data, stdout=subprocess.PIPE,
                           stderr=subprocess.PIPE, env=env)
        return p.stdout if p.returncode == 0 else None

    # Untimed warm-up: materialize/validate the native helper and cached inputs.
    for path, n, sha in cases:
        out, _ = run_file(path, sha)
        if out is None:
            return 0
    if run_bytes((root / "edge_in.txt").read_bytes()) != (root / "edge_out.txt").read_bytes():
        return 0
    if run_bytes((root / "empty_in.txt").read_bytes()) != b"":
        return 0
    big = b"  12 -1 9999999999999999999999999999999999 +2 -0\n"
    if run_bytes(big) != b"-1\n0\n2\n12\n9999999999999999999999999999999999\n":
        return 0

    # Timed end-to-end runs; take the best time for each case to suppress OS noise.
    reps = 3
    times = [[] for _ in cases]
    for _ in range(reps):
        for i, (path, n, sha) in enumerate(cases):
            out, dt = run_file(path, sha)
            if out is None:
                return 0
            times[i].append(dt)
    best = sum(min(t) for t in times)
    total = sum(n for _, n, _ in cases)
    return int(total / best) if best > 0 else 0

try:
    result = main()
except Exception:
    result = 0
print(result)
